Bhelasaṃhitā
med. by Bhela, disciple of Ātreya Punarvasu.
q. in Toḍarānanda, Weber 941; q. by Tīsaṭa in Cikitsākalikā, Weber 947; by Jagannātha in Yogasaṅgraha, Weber 958; by Vāgbhaṭa in his Aṣṭāṅgahṛdaya, MD. 13072; by Vācaka Dīpacandra in his Laṅghanapathyanirṇaya, BORI. D. XVI. i. 235.
See Āyurved kā Bṛhat Itihās, p.. 107, 177-80; also Broomfield, SBE. Ath. V. Intro. p.. xx, xxi.
For a study, see Tsutomu Yama7shita, Towards a Critical Ed.. of the Bhelasaṃhitā, Journal of the European Ayurvedic Society, No. 5 (1997). p.. 19-24.
Burnell 63b. Filliozat I. 80. IO. 6224. Kavīndrācārya 951 (ºtantra). Radh. 32. R. A. Sastri III. p. 233. TD. 11085. Trav. Uni. T-1446 (inc.). Triv. Cur. VII. 92 (inc.). WIHM. I. 703. 704 (corrected leaves of the text).
